thread.title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for June, 7th (AAPL, ABF, BAG, BATS, BAYN, COP, DCG, DVO, ENEL, FST)

author: ABMN Staff
title: Research Analysts’ Price Target Changes for June, 7th (AAPL, ABF, BAG, BATS, BAYN, COP, DCG, DVO, ENEL, FST)
text:
Research Analysts’ price target changes for Thursday, June 7th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $210.00 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple alerts:
Associated British Foods (LON:ABF) had its target price trimmed by Societe Generale from GBX 3,650 ($48.60) to GBX 3,100 ($41.27). The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. A.G. Barr (LON:BAG) had its price target raised by Societe Generale from GBX 758 ($10.09) to GBX 775 ($10.32). The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
British American Tobacco (LON:BATS) had its target price trimmed by Societe Generale from GBX 5,800 ($77.22) to GBX 5,500 ($73.23). The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Bayer (FRA:BAYN) was given a €130.00 ($151.16) price target by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
CompuGroup Medical (ETR:COP) was given a €50.00 ($58.14) price target by analysts at Warburg Research. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Dairy Crest Group (LON:DCG) had its target price reduced by Societe Generale from GBX 610 ($8.12) to GBX 530 ($7.06). The firm currently has a hold rating on the stock.
Devro (LON:DVO) had its target price raised by Societe Generale from GBX 190 ($2.53) to GBX 225 ($3.00). They currently have a hold rating on the stock.
Enel (BIT:ENEL) was given a €5.30 ($6.16) price target by analysts at Deutsche Bank AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Frontier Smart Technologies Group (LON:FST) had its target price reduced by Peel Hunt from GBX 150 ($2.00) to GBX 85 ($1.13). The firm currently has an add rating on the stock.
Assicurazioni Generali (BIT:G) was given a €20.40 ($23.72) price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
International Consolidated Airlns Grp (LON:IAG) had its target price increased by BNP Paribas from GBX 750 ($9.99) to GBX 800 ($10.65). BNP Paribas currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Imperial Brands (LON:IMB) had its price target cut by Societe Generale from GBX 4,500 ($59.91) to GBX 3,200 ($42.60). Societe Generale currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Joules (LON:JOUL) had its target price increased by Liberum Capital from GBX 410 ($5.46) to GBX 420 ($5.59). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Merlin Entertainments (LON:MERL) had its target price increased by Peel Hunt from GBX 375 ($4.99) to GBX 450 ($5.99). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Plus500 (LON:PLUS) had its target price raised by Liberum Capital from GBX 1,729 ($23.02) to GBX 1,994 ($26.55). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Reckitt Benckiser (LON:RB) had its target price lowered by Societe Generale from £100 ($133.14) to GBX 6,500 ($86.54). Societe Generale currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Ramsdens (LON:RFX) had its target price increased by Liberum Capital from GBX 204 ($2.72) to GBX 214 ($2.85). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Tate & Lyle (LON:TATE) had its price target reduced by Societe Generale from GBX 780 ($10.38) to GBX 750 ($9.99). They currently have a buy rating on the stock.
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) was given a $411.00 price target by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Wizz Air (LON:WIZZ) had its target price lowered by BNP Paribas from GBX 3,300 ($43.94) to GBX 3,200 ($42.60). The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Apple Apple
